verses.text: The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

segments.text: The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

verses.text: Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.

segments.text: Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.

verses.text: The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.

verses.text: Above the roar of many waters—the mighty breakers of the sea—the LORD on high is majestic.

verses.text: Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, for all the days to come.
